resources.string: No ROM file found. Please load a ROM.
Invalid ROM (expected a classic V-pet dump or verified D-Power EU 1.01)
Glyph disconnected — open this toy in Nothing Glyph Toys
Glyph output failed — reconnect the toy
Reset %1$s? This starts a new pet and replaces its autosave. Manual save slots are kept.
Save to a manual slot below, then reset when you are ready.
Paused by quiet hours. Controls resume when the pet resumes.

Play on the Glyph Matrix. Normal view keeps original pixels and crops the sides. Enable Fit full LCD to see the whole screen at a smaller size.
Flick left or right: Left / Right. Move toward or away from you: Up / Down. Hold and release the Glyph button without a flick: Up. A short press switches Glyph toys. Hold the Glyph button and flick left: Step. Hold the Glyph button and flick right: Card.
Step sends one emulated step contact. Enable walking or automatic steps in Step Training. Screen buttons are optional.

Walking steps use your phone’s step detector to press the emulated Step input. Counts only while D-Power is running; Stop and DND Freeze pause it. Keep the pet started for screen-off walking. No past steps are imported.
No step detector is available. Use automatic steps, the manual Step button or Glyph hold-and-flick.
Walking steps need Physical activity permission. Manual Step still works.

Show the phone’s local time in 24-hour format with hours above and minutes below the D-Power LCD, using tiny NanoFont 3×4 digits. Visible on every game screen while enabled; does not set the ROM’s clock.
Automatic step rate, 0.5 to 4 steps per second

Sends the same Step input as walking. Runs only while the pet runs; Stop and DND Freeze pause it. Resumes when you start the pet. Walking and manual steps take priority; automatic steps do not build a backlog.
Off: original-size pixels, cropped sides. On: the entire LCD, smaller with correct proportions.
Up to 30 frames per second instead of 15. May use more power; the pet clock stays at normal speed.
Settings save automatically. ROM files, manual saves and DND scheduling remain on the main screen.
